name: Sky130 Trng
description: Canary — sky130 true random number generator. AI-designed, open-source.

rows.target: N-way array of independent free-running ring oscillators, XOR-combined ahead of a single sampler; N re-sized from a jitter budget at the entropy-binding corner
rows.stretch: metastability hybrid as a secondary tap

rows.target: > 1 Mbps sustained at the raw tap, binding at the slowest-RO corner
H₀ = 0.5 bit/sample as a design *target* at the entropy-binding corner — a sizing input, not a claim, until measured
designed-for-SP 800-90B (raw access + RCT/APT + entropy-source model); validation deferred to measured silicon
non-vetted CRC-32 LFSR compression, K = 8 (256 raw bits in : one 32-bit word out)
rows.stretch: vetted conditioner if the area budget allows

rows.target: continuous RCT + APT on the raw stream; cutoffs re-derived from sky130 noise/leakage corners, not copied from gf180
< 500 µW active; idle target set after a sky130 leakage survey
−40 … +125 °C; supply per sky130 device flavor (1.8 V core, 3.3 V I/O devices available) — confirm before ratification
streaming, mode-selectable raw / conditioned; raw access always available and never gated
